ORACLE_STATS_OFF_CONTRACT: The Oracle stats payload failed validation.
COMMS_NOT_CONFIGURED: The comms card has no configuration.
COMMS_OFF_CONTRACT: The comms payload did not match the contract.
COMMS_READBACK_MISMATCH: The card did not read back as written.
COMMS_STALE: The comms data is older than the freshness limit.
COMMS_UNREACHABLE: The comms endpoint could not be reached.
TODOIST_UNREADABLE: The Todoist open-task count could not be read; the launcher shows the last verified count as STALE, or a dash before the first one.
COMMS_TODOIST_DIVERGED: The Todoist label was written on one callout but not the other (Dashboard unreadable, wrong shape, or its write failed).
Check the Dashboard label and its block id setting; retried next tick.
COMMS_WRITE_FAILED: The card could not be written to Notion.
NEEDS_ATTENTION: Attention state: a message needs a look.
